import.error.invalid_link.body: Paste a track, playlist or profile link from SoundCloud, Yandex Music, YouTube, Spotify, Apple Music or Deezer.

import.error.not_found.body: Check the link. The playlist may have been deleted.
import.error.private.title: Private playlist
import.error.private.body: Make it public in {service} privacy settings or sign in.
import.error.region.title: Service unavailable in your region
import.error.region.body: Try enabling or disabling your VPN, or changing its location, then retry.

import.error.empty.title: Playlist is empty
import.error.empty.body: Choose another playlist or add tracks at the source.

update.signedHint: The release signature and app integrity are verified before installation.
update.permissionHint: Allow updates from SoundSense in the Android settings that opened, then return and tap Install update.
update.error.network: The server and mirrors are unavailable. Try again later.
update.error.signature: The release signature could not be verified. The file was rejected.
update.error.rollback: The source offers an older version than the installed or previously verified release.
update.error.download: Could not download and verify the build. Please try again.
update.error.install: Android could not open the update installer.
update.error.unsupported: No build is available for this platform yet.

audio.allHint: Global settings. Tracks with their own settings keep them.
library.overviewHint: Everything you collect and listen to.
lyrics.failedSub: Check your connection and open lyrics again.
background.title: Background playback
background.hint: Allow unrestricted battery use so Android can keep music playing with the screen off. This opens the system permission dialog.
background.unrestricted: Unrestricted background use is allowed. Playback continues with the screen off.
background.restricted: Android may restrict playback while the screen is off.
account.codeHint: Open Yandex and enter this code. Enter your password only on the Yandex website.
account.waiting: Waiting for approval. Return to the app after signing in.
account.hint: An account provides access to private collections and subscription tracks. Public collections can be imported by link without signing in.
account.plainStorage: There is no system password store, so the sign-in is kept in a file only your user can read.
account.openFailed: Could not open the sign-in page
import.appleExportHint: Choose JSON or CSV files from your Apple Music export. You can select multiple files, then choose which collections to import.
import.multiHint: Select liked tracks, individual playlists or several collections together.
import.countOnImport: Count will be checked during import
import.error.incomplete.title: The service returned an incomplete list
import.error.incomplete.body: Import stopped to avoid losing part of your collection. Try again or choose the service export files.
import.privacy.ytm: In YouTube Music, edit the playlist visibility to Public or Unlisted.
import.privacy.apple: Share your Apple Music playlist or choose export files.
import.privacy.spotify: Make the Spotify playlist public or choose an Account data ZIP export.
import.privacy.deezer: Make your Deezer playlist public and copy its link.
import.publicAccessHint: Make the collection public in the service and paste its link. Spotify and Apple Music also support export files.
import.yandexPublicHint: A link is enough for public liked tracks and playlists. Paste it and choose what to import.
home.forYouSub: Picked from your likes and history
home.forYouEmpty: Like or play a few tracks and a selection will appear here.
home.forYouError: Couldn't build a selection. Check the connection or VPN.
onboarding.homeHint: Charts and recommendations can be changed later in settings.
setting.beatPulseHint: The player background pulses with the track's rhythm.
setting.beatParticlesHint: Sparks fly off the cover to the beat.
setting.liveCoversHint: Animated covers are looked up on Apple Music by title and artist.

plugins.catalogHint: Reviewed plugins from the SoundSense repository. They are checked by SHA-256 and installed switched off: review the permissions and enable.
plugins.catalogError: Could not load the catalog. Check your connection.
plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.hint: Beta. A plugin runs separately from the app and sees only what you allow. A plugin from a .ssplugin file is installed turned off: check its permissions and turn it on.
plugins.installed: Plugin “{name}” installed — turn it on in the list
plugins.permission.ui.trackMenu: Add items to the track menu
plugins.noScreen: This plugin has no screen yet
sync.title: Device sync
sync.hint: Likes, playlists, history and settings. Directly between devices, no account and no server of ours. Devices exchange changes while both are open; anything changed apart catches up the next time they meet.
sync.codeHint: Enter this code on the other device: Settings → Device sync → “I have a code”.
sync.error.code: The code has 8 letters and digits, like K7M2-9QXP.
sync.error.notFound: Code not found or expired. Show a new code on the other device.
sync.error.server: Could not reach the pairing server. Check the internet connection or VPN.
library.noAlbums: No albums in the file tags. If the folder was imported earlier, import it again to read albums and track numbers.
onboarding.syncProfileHint: Bring over likes, playlists, history and settings
onboarding.syncSteps: On the device that already has SoundSense, open Settings → Device sync → “Show code” and enter the code here.
update.phase.behind: The chosen channel is older than the installed version ({version}). The update arrives once it releases a newer build.
